title: Rearrange Characters to Make Target String
summary: Given two strings s and target, determine the greatest number of target copies that can be created by rearranging letters from s.
statement: Given two strings s and target, determine the greatest number of target copies that can be created by rearranging letters from s.
constraints: Characters of s may be rearranged and each occurrence may be used at most once.
Each target copy consumes its full character multiset, including repeated target letters.
Return the greatest number of complete copies.
hints: Count available source characters and required target characters.
For each distinct target character, integer-divide available count by required count.
Return the minimum of those per-character copy limits.
Every copy must satisfy every character requirement, so the smallest ratio is necessary; using that many copies is also sufficient.
